request: Create a single-process inventory reservation API with 10 units of stock. Allow clients to inspect the available quantity and reserve units without overselling.
criteria: GET /stock returns 200 with the available quantity. POST /reservations?units=3 returns 201 and leaves 7 of the initial 10 units.
Reject reservations larger than available stock with 409 and leave the available quantity unchanged.
Reject zero or negative reservations with 400 without changing the available quantity.
